BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

2. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business.
   C. Treat Social Responsibility of Business as rumours only.
   D. Say Social Responsibility of Business never happens in Kenya.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Budgeting in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Budgeting in Business never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Budgeting in Business as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business.

5. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Money.
   B. Say Money never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Money as rumours only.
   D. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

7. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum.

8. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.
   C. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Banking as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of as rumours only.
   B. Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of.

11. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.
   C. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Business Activities and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. A — Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. B — Nairobi

4. A — Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. D — Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
